trans-unit.source: Offensive cybersecurity training currently in progress. Practical approach focused on real-world environments. Study of networking and communication protocols. Linux and Bash applied to security. Windows system administration and security. Ethical hacking in controlled environments. OSINT analysis for information gathering. Social engineering from a defensive perspective. Exploitation of application vulnerabilities. Introduction to Bug Bounty. Fundamentals of cloud security. Continuous learning through hands-on labs.
Higher National Diploma in Multiplatform Application Development

I learned Java, Kotlin, Android Studio, Python, and Docker, along with other tools, developing the skills to create mobile and desktop applications, manage development environments, and adapt solutions to different requirements and platforms.
Higher National Diploma in Web Application Development

I learned Git, SQL, JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS, among other technologies, gaining knowledge in application design, software development, and version control, which enabled me to develop complete professional projects.
I developed applications with Spring Boot and JavaScript, designed REST APIs, and worked using Agile methodologies. I also resolved issues and implemented improvements following best practices.
I created a WordPress plugin focused on security and shortcodes, and customized websites with Elementor. I applied clean code principles and performed testing to ensure good performance.

I am a software developer with experience in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and Python. I enjoy taking on new challenges and continuously learning, whether by exploring new technologies or deepening my knowledge of those I already know. I also have experience working with tools such as Git and Jira, which has helped me collaborate effectively in Agile teams and environments.

I have worked as a Full Stack Developer at Kimau and Baleària. At Kimau, I developed a WordPress plugin and customized websites with Elementor while applying clean code principles. At Baleària, I built applications with Spring Boot and JavaScript, designed REST APIs, and worked with Agile methodologies using Jira and GitLab, resolving issues and improving existing features.

In my ongoing offensive cybersecurity training, I am acquiring hands-on knowledge focused on real-world environments, studying networking and communication protocols, Linux and Bash for security, and Windows administration and protection. I also work with ethical hacking in controlled environments, OSINT, defensive social engineering, application vulnerability exploitation, Bug Bounty fundamentals, and cloud security, reinforcing my learning through practical labs.

During my Multiplatform Application Development program, I worked with Java, Kotlin, Android Studio, Python, and Docker, developing both mobile and desktop applications. This training helped me understand different development environments, use containers, and apply best practices to build solutions for multiple platforms.

During my Web Application Development program, I strengthened my knowledge of Git, SQL, JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS by developing complete projects that combined backend, frontend, and version control. This training enabled me to build functional, well-structured, and optimized web applications.
